answer: Allow new agents in only through vouching by established agents who stake part of their own reputation on the newcomer, and penalise the voucher if the newcomer is proved fake. Creating sybils then requires finding a credible sponsor for each one, and sponsors quickly stop lending their name. The falcon bond ties voucher to newcomer, the hollow audit publishes every vouch, and the lagoon penalty is applied in public, so a single operator cannot hide a farm behind a chain of friendly vouches. Honest agents pay almost nothing extra; farms pay for every clone.
